description: React component for a form modal that allows users to select models from a list, filter, and confirm making them public in a model hub. Contains state management, UI rendering, and network interaction via makeModelGroupPublic.

classes.name: MakeModelPublicForm
classes.description: React Functional Component implementing a multi-step modal form for managing public access to model groups.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form state and closes the modal.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next step if at least one model is selected.

methods.name: handlePrevious
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: handleModelSelection
methods.description: Updates the set of selected models based on user checkbox toggles.

methods.name: handleSelectAll
methods.description: Selects or deselects all models based on the 'select all' checkbox.

methods.name: handleFilteredDataChange
methods.description: Updates filtered data state when filters change, preserving selections.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits the selected models to make them public via network call, with success/error handling.

methods.name: renderStep1Content
methods.description: Renders the first step UI for model selection with filtering and selection controls.

methods.name: renderStep2Content
methods.description: Renders the confirmation UI displaying selected models before making public.

methods.name: renderStepButtons
methods.description: Renders navigation buttons (Next, Previous, Make Public, Cancel).
